description: Use this when the user asks who is buying or selling a Polymarket market, why its price moved, where the money is going, who the biggest holders are, or (with no market) what the whales are doing across Polymarket. For a market or event: dollars traded and net direction per outcome, distinct wallets, the largest trades, the wallets that moved the most money, and for a single market the biggest current holders. With no market: the largest trades across all of Polymarket and the markets drawing that money. Traders appear by public username when they set one; pass a wallet to pm_portfolio for its full track record.

market.description: A polymarket.com link, or a market or event slug from pm_search. Omit to see the largest trades across all of Polymarket.

min_usd.description: Without a market: only trades of at least this many dollars (default $10,000).

outcome.description: For a multi-outcome event: limit to one outcome by its label.

name: pm_flow
title: Who is trading
